title: More Information
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
The billing schema extension is an entity in SAP IS-U contract billing that is integrated in the billing schema according to the data
model. The billing schema extension contains the conditional billing program and the rate relationship group with the rate
relationships.

You establish which rates are billed and the order in which they are to be processed in the billing schema. You define the
relationship between these rates in the billing schema extension: Which rates are used as basic rates for the entire billing period
and which rates are only used as conditional rates for active TOU exceptions to supplement or substitute the basic rates. Basic
rates and conditional rates must be used in the same schema and be defined with the same relationship in rate determination.

The conditional billing program defined in the billing schema extension is used to activate conditional rates. Assigning conditional
billing programs to TOU exception programs executes the corresponding rates in the billing schema extension for an active TOU
exception.

More Information

Rate Relationships

Conditional Billing Program

Activities

Create Billing Schema Extension

Conditional Billing Program

The conditional billing program is used to activate conditional rates for an active TOU exception.

You define the conditional billing program in the billing schema extension and assign it to TOU exception programs. The conditional
billing program refers to a billing schema. You also assign conditional rates to the conditional billing program. These assignments
mean the system executes the corresponding conditional rates for the billing schema extension for an active TOU exception.

The conditional billing program means rates can be controlled with a greater degree of flexibility during an exception period. You
can assign the conditional billing program to several rate relationship groups and several TOU exception programs. This gives you
several options for representing specific contract conditions and different types of rates including those for interval customers.

Rate Relationships

Use

In conditional billing, the relationship between rates plays a very important role. Rates are used as basic rates for the entire billing

period. They are only used as conditional rates for active time-of-use exceptions in order to supplement or substitute the basic
rates. Rate relationships between basic rates and conditional rates are defined in the billing schema extension.

Rate Relationship Groups

The rate relationship group specifies a rate fact group to combine a basic rate with all conditional rates that are assigned to this
